verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Warp splits terminal output into per-command Blocks, which is the structural equivalent of prompt/command marks: a user praises 'chunking the output into blocks', and the docs mention restoring recent Blocks. Nothing in the pack documents keyboard or UI navigation for jumping between those blocks or prompts in scrollback, and nothing describes the shell-integration mechanism behind them. Missing for 10: documented jump-to-previous/next prompt or block navigation, a description of how shell integration produces the marks, and hands-on corroboration of scrollback navigation.
